rationale: Wind damage to the roof structure (shingles on overhang) of the policyholder's home is clear property_damage to the dwelling.
claim_summary: Wind event last weekend removed four shingles from back porch overhang. No interior damage or water intrusion. Estimated repair cost $400. Requires roofer quote and repair authorization.

case_facts.description: wind blew four shingles off overhang, no interior damage or water intrusion
